channel.desc: Comedy 2022 After being ignored for many years, historian Philippa Langley decides to follow her guts and challenge academic immobility by leading a group of notable historians to search for the remains of King Richard III. Sally Hawkins, Steve Coogan, Harry Lloyd, Shonagh Price, Lewis Macleod, Helen Katamba, Jenny Douglas, Stephen Frears, Steve Coogan, Philippa Langley.
